text: Your parents ask if you want a birthday party this year.

choices.label: Invite the whole class
choices.resultText: You had a huge birthday party and invited your whole class. So much fun!

choices.label: Keep it small with family
choices.resultText: You had a small birthday celebration with just your family.

text: Some kids at the park dare you to climb the tallest tree.

choices.label: Climb all the way to the top
choices.resultText: You climbed to the very top and fell out near the end, breaking your arm. Worth it for the bragging rights.

choices.label: Stay on the low branches
choices.resultText: You stuck to the low branches and stayed safe.

text: A classmate starts picking on you at recess.

choices.label: Stand up to them
choices.resultText: You stood up to the bully. It turned into a scuffle, but they left you alone after that.

choices.label: Tell a teacher
choices.resultText: You told a teacher, who stepped in and handled it.

choices.label: Ignore it and walk away
choices.resultText: You ignored it, but it kept bothering you.

text: Your class is having a science fair. What do you build?

choices.label: An ambitious baking-soda volcano
choices.resultText: You spent weeks building a baking-soda volcano for the science fair.

choices.label: A simple poster board
choices.resultText: You threw together a simple poster board the night before. It was fine.

text: It's time to present the volcano you built for the science fair.

choices.label: Present it yourself
choices.resultText: You presented confidently and took first place at the science fair!

choices.label: Let a friend help present it
choices.resultText: Your friend helped present it. You placed third, but it was still fun.
